title: A-GRASPQ-FS: Adaptive GRASPQ Feature Selection with Self-Tuning Subset Size
description: A-GRASPQ-FS is a scikit-learn compatible adaptive feature selector based on a reactive GRASP metaheuristic. It jointly optimizes subset cardinality and feature composition for a given dataset-classifier pair.

creators.name: Passos, Diego
creators.affiliation: Instituto Superior de Engenharia de Lisboa, Instituto Politécnico de Lisboa, Portugal
